replies.author: DreamNotDeferred
replies.body:
Amazing work, just did a test sprite gen. Please announce when the feature in the video is released, I'll definitely buy in. 

Question: the membership is called lifetime, but it's includes 2500 credits. Assuming you run out of credits you would have to buy again correct? I'm not trying to nitpick, I'm just asking for clarification. Even if you do have to buy again, I think $25 is more than fair for 166 sprite generations.

Thanks.

replies.author: YamiYugi333
replies.body: Ya it’s one time for full access. Once you run out of credits you can buy more. A single sprite gen is 1 credit but for the animation it will cost 100 credits.

replies.author: DreamNotDeferred
replies.body: Thanks for responding. So, The run animation in the video would be 100 credits, Right? All animations are a flat 100?

replies.author: YamiYugi333
replies.body: Yes all animations will be 100 flat.
